title: StateDigest
description: Compact carry-forward state surviving compaction boundaries. Adapted from MindSeed's state_digest concept. Written before compaction, read after compaction.

current_task.description: What the agent is currently working on

active_seed_ids.description: Seed IDs relevant to the current session

pending_actions.description: Remaining steps in the current task

compaction_count.description: How many compactions have occurred in this session lineage

last_compaction.description: Timestamp of the most recent compaction

session_lineage.description: Chain of session IDs from oldest to current
